blockingFindings.title: Production OpenAI schema parse failures bypass the required repair retries and typed 422
blockingFindings.requirement: One initial model attempt plus at most two schema/diversity repair attempts, ending in typed 422 when validation cannot be repaired.
evidence: backend/app/openai_client.py:61 calls AsyncOpenAI.responses.parse with a Pydantic response model.
backend/app/main.py:181-197 performs the three-attempt validation loop only after the adapter returns a raw JSON string.
backend/tests/test_recipe_generation.py and backend/tests/test_cooking_advice.py inject raw invalid strings through FakeAI; they never exercise OpenAIResponsesTransport.
backend/tests/test_openai_client.py records GPT56Adapter request fields but never invokes OpenAIResponsesTransport.execute.

smallestReproduction.command: backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -c "import sys; sys.path.insert(0, 'backend'); from openai import APIError; from openai.lib._parsing._responses import parse_text; from app.models import RecipeGenerateResponse; print('validation_is_api_error=', issubclass(__import__('pydantic').ValidationError, APIError)); parse_text('{}', RecipeGenerateResponse)"
smallestReproduction.result: validation_is_api_error=False, followed by pydantic_core.ValidationError from the same SDK parse path used by responses.parse
smallestReproduction.expected: The invalid provider schema should count as a failed validation attempt; the service should retry at most twice and then return error.code=model_validation_failed with HTTP 422.
smallestReproduction.actual: The non-API Pydantic ValidationError escapes OpenAIResponsesTransport before parse_model_output can retry; no handler maps it to the typed 422 contract, so the production request becomes an unhandled 500 path.

blockingFindings.minimalFixDirection: At the production transport seam, convert SDK Pydantic parse failures into a validation result the existing three-attempt loop can consume, and add a transport-level regression test proving 3 attempts then typed 422. Do not broaden transport retries for API/network failures.

automatedVerification.command: uv venv backend/.venv --python 3.14 && uv pip install --python backend/.venv/Scripts/python.exe -r backend/requirements.txt
automatedVerification.result: Disposable CPython 3.14.3 venv created; all 57 packages resolved from pinned requirements and installed.
31 passed in 1.96s; no skips or xfails reported.
No violations in 15 files. backend/app/main.py independently measured 248 pure LOC, inside the checker's 200-250 warning band.
All three independent repeats passed; each run was 2 passed, 5 deselected in 0.16-0.18s. Assertions were inspected: exact allowed/rejected counts are 20/1 for recipes and 50/1 for advice.

implementationInspection.typedBoundaries: Pydantic v2 frozen extra-forbid models cover UUID IDs, nonnegative versions, canonical g/ml/count units, positive milli-unit quantities, bounded request fields, exact three recipe responses, and typed advice.
implementationInspection.firebaseBearer: Production dependency uses HTTPBearer and firebase_admin.auth.verify_id_token; expired, invalid, revoked, and disabled-user tokens map to the typed 401 path; no production fake bypass was found.
implementationInspection.quota: HMAC-SHA256 hides raw UIDs. QuotaService selects exact 20/50 UID and 2000/5000 global caps, uses UTC route/day document IDs, and computes ceil seconds to next UTC midnight. FirestoreCounterBackend reads and conditionally writes the per-UID and single global route/day documents in one transactional callback.
implementationInspection.recipeBinding: Response validation rejects duplicate normalized titles, fewer than two normalized cuisines or techniques, duplicate tracked IDs within a recipe, unknown UUIDs, and version/unit/amount mismatches. Exactly three is enforced by the Pydantic response model.
implementationInspection.providerControls: The production adapter selects gpt-5.6, passes store=false, supplies Pydantic response models, separates system instructions from JSON user_data, and passes images as data URLs. Injection-like pantry/note text remained solely in the user-data envelope in the inspected test and live request; it could not mutate model, schema_name, or store=false.
implementationInspection.resourcesAndLogs: Photo reads are 64 KiB chunks with an 8 MiB in-memory ceiling and UploadFile close in endpoint finally. Metadata logging includes method/path/status only and not Authorization or request bodies.

adversarialMatrix.malformed_input: IN: strict request/response models, unknown/duplicate tracked IDs, version/unit/amount mismatches, diversity, 256 KiB JSON, and 8 MiB+1 photo were inspected or exercised. The production schema-parser exception gap is the blocking failure.
adversarialMatrix.prompt_injection: IN: injection-like pantry and notes strings were sent through live HTTP and inspected at GPT56Adapter. They stayed JSON user_data, absent from instructions, while model=gpt-5.6, schema_name=recipe_set, and store=false remained fixed.
adversarialMatrix.stale_state: IN: tests and code were inspected for non-UTC input conversion, next-midnight Retry-After, per-route/day counter keys, and atomic cap outcomes.
adversarialMatrix.dirty_worktree: IN: HEAD and the exact T3 commit/tree were pinned before review. Concurrent out-of-scope T2 activity was observed only under android/**, .omo/start-work/ledger.jsonl, .debug-journal.md, and task-2-* evidence; it was neither read as T3 evidence nor modified/cleaned.
adversarialMatrix.hung_or_long_commands: IN: pytest/build/curl commands had bounded tool waits or curl max-time; uvicorn readiness was explicit and both live processes were terminated.
adversarialMatrix.flaky_tests: IN: concurrent quota boundary tests passed three fresh repeats with exact 20/50 allowed and one rejected assertions.
adversarialMatrix.misleading_success_output: IN: HTTP status and bodies, typed error codes, post-probe fake state, Docker image ID, container health body, test assertions, and cleanup state were inspected rather than trusting command labels.
adversarialMatrix.cancel_resume: PARTLY IN: server-side upload resources are closed in finally and tests cover success/413/422. Client resume, background retry, and interrupted photo re-upload are OUT for T3 and owned by T5; T3 exposes no resumable job or automatic transport retry.
adversarialMatrix.repeated_interruptions: OUT by design: T3 requests are stateless HTTP calls with no resumable workflow; repeated client interruption/retry semantics belong to T5. The only T3 retry loop is validation-only and bounded to three calls.

risks: The blocker means the committed green tests overstate production retry coverage: fake adapters return raw malformed JSON, but the real SDK parses before the retry loop.
Firestore transaction correctness was inspected statically and quota semantics were stress-tested with the atomic fake; live Firestore contention is intentionally deferred to T11.

FastAPI/Starlette parses multipart input into UploadFile before the endpoint's 8 MiB chunked read, so the endpoint ceiling does not by itself prove an ingress-level temporary-spool bound for arbitrarily large bodies.
backend/app/main.py is 248 pure LOC, in the programming skill warning band; the next substantive edit should split a responsibility before crossing 250.
